end.summary:
- Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
- Counted a bundle as ten when finding the total after reminders.
- Identified the 1 in teen numbers as one ten with a note-and-bundle comparison.
- Corrected mix-ups about counting a bundle as one and reading 15 as one plus five.
- Compared the correct order of digits in 14 and 41.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making teen numbers with one bundle of ten and some loose ones. They used the note and bundle examples to understand that the 1 in 15 or 19 means one ten, and later explained this correctly. They also corrected the mix-up about counting a bundle as only one item; the same idea was applied again later. At home, ask Saanvi to build numbers 11–20 with one group of ten and loose objects, then say “ten and ___.”
